title: 1991-92 NBA Hoops #30 Charles Barkley Philadelphia 76ers Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1991-92 NBA Hoops trading card features Charles Barkley, a renowned player for the Philadelphia 76ers. The card is an original from the Panini Chronicles Basketball series and has the card number 30. It is a single product and is not autographed. 

The card is perfect for collectors of sports trading cards, especially those who are fans of basketball and the NBA. It is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this piece of basketball history.
